title: CircularDictEngineContract
description: Strongly typed schema for TTZip power-of-two circular dictionary update engine and match copy dispatcher

dict_size.description: Power-of-two dictionary buffer capacity in bytes (32KB to 512MB)

write_pos.description: Current circular dictionary write head position

total_written.description: Cumulative bytes written into dictionary across all iterations

fast_path_hits.description: Count of match copies executed via zero-branch linear Fast-Path

slow_path_hits.description: Count of match copies executed via boundary wrapping Slow-Path

path_type.description: Execution path chosen for the last match copy operation
